name: Service request status
description: Open311 GeoReport v2 only defines open and closed. That hides what residents most want to know: has anyone started on this yet? These terms add that detail, and still map back to Open311 - anything but closed, rejected, or duplicate maps to open.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Open
hasDefinedTerm.description: Received, not yet being worked on. Maps to Open311 open.

hasDefinedTerm.name: In progress
hasDefinedTerm.description: Assigned and being worked on. Maps to Open311 open.

hasDefinedTerm.name: On hold
hasDefinedTerm.description: Acknowledged, but stuck — for example, waiting on a contractor or a season. Maps to Open311 open.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Closed
hasDefinedTerm.description: The work is finished. Maps to Open311 closed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Rejected
hasDefinedTerm.description: Closed with no action, for example because it's outside the authority's job. Maps to Open311 closed — but keeping this separate stops a resident from reporting the same thing again.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Duplicate
hasDefinedTerm.description: Closed because it was already reported. Maps to Open311 closed.
